links.outcome: LLM medication extraction accuracy against manually annotated gold standard
links.effect: Precision 0.85, recall 1.00, F1 0.92 for unique medication identification; 174 false positives from parsing or normalization errors; no hallucinations.
links.quote: Comparison yielded a precision of 0.85, recall of 1.00, and an F1-score of 0.92 for unique medication identification.

links.outcome: LLM performance on representative real-world clinical notes against a reference standard
links.effect: Validated on 100 MIMIC-IV discharge summaries against manual gold standard; precision 0.85, recall 1.00, F1 0.92.
links.quote: We retrospectively validated an LLM system on 100 randomly sampled Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV (MIMIC-IV) discharge summaries.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance on retrospective clinical notes from MIMIC-IV to extract medications for DILI surveillance without testing specific deployment practices or operational guardrails.
